RUT.1.1-2.text: Elimelech and his family move to Moab during a famine

RUT.1.3-5.text: Naomi’s husband and two sons die in Moab

RUT.1.6-7.text: Naomi hears of food in Judah and leaves Moab

RUT.1.8-10.text: Naomi urges Orpah and Ruth to go back home

RUT.1.11-13.text: Naomi says she has no sons for Orpah and Ruth to marry

RUT.1.14-15.text: Orpah goes back, but Ruth stays with Naomi

RUT.1.16-18.text: Ruth promises to stay with Naomi and follow her God

RUT.1.19-21.text: Naomi arrives in Bethlehem and says she is bitter

RUT.1.22-22.text: Naomi and Ruth arrive in Bethlehem at barley harvest

RUT.2.1-2.text: Ruth asks Naomi to let her glean in the fields

RUT.2.3-4.text: Ruth gleans in Boaz’s field and Boaz greets the workers

RUT.2.5-7.text: Boaz asks the foreman who Ruth is

RUT.2.8-9.text: Boaz tells Ruth to stay in his fields and be safe

RUT.2.10-12.text: Boaz praises Ruth for her care of Naomi

RUT.2.13-13.text: Ruth thanks Boaz for his kind words

RUT.2.14-14.text: Boaz invites Ruth to eat with the harvesters

RUT.2.15-16.text: Boaz orders his men not to insult Ruth

RUT.2.17-18.text: Ruth gleans until evening and brings grain to Naomi

RUT.2.19-20.text: Naomi learns that Boaz is a close relative

RUT.2.21-22.text: Naomi tells Ruth to stay with the women of Boaz

RUT.2.23-23.text: Ruth gleans until the harvests end and lives with Naomi

RUT.3.1-2.text: Naomi wants to find a resting place for Ruth

RUT.3.3-5.text: Naomi tells Ruth to go to Boaz at the threshing floor

RUT.3.6-7.text: Ruth does what Naomi said and lies at Boaz’s feet

RUT.3.8-9.text: Ruth asks Boaz to spread his garment over her

RUT.3.10-11.text: Boaz blesses Ruth and promises to help her

RUT.3.12-13.text: Boaz says a nearer redeemer must be asked first

RUT.3.14-15.text: Ruth leaves early with six measures of barley from Boaz

RUT.3.16-18.text: Ruth reports to Naomi, who tells her to wait

RUT.4.1-2.text: Boaz meets the other redeemer and ten elders at the gate

RUT.4.3-4.text: The other redeemer agrees to buy Naomi’s land

RUT.4.5-6.text: The other redeemer refuses when Ruth is included

RUT.4.7-8.text: The other redeemer gives his sandal to Boaz

RUT.4.9-10.text: Boaz tells the elders he has bought the land and Ruth

RUT.4.11-12.text: The elders and people bless Boaz and Ruth

RUT.4.13-15.text: Ruth bears a son, and the women praise God for Naomi

RUT.4.16-17.text: Naomi cares for Obed, the grandfather of David
